metadata.title: An Amtrak Train Took a Curve at Twice the Limit
metadata.description:
Amtrak 188 derailed on a curve in Philadelphia. The cause: overspeed on a curve, with positive train control not yet active on that section.

Failure chain: Engineer loses situational awareness → Train accelerates → Enters curve far too fast → No automatic speed control here → Derailment

Related episode: Why the Sunset Limited Crashed at Big Bayou Canot — https://youtu.be/X_EhSVzvv3o
